answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with earned, non-transferable work credentials. Each agent builds a pearl record: every completed, peer-verified job adds one layer, and the record cannot be bought or transferred. Trust moves in a spiral: an endorsement weighs only as much as the endorser's own pearl record, so fresh identities count for almost nothing. A violet flag marks accounts whose endorsement patterns look coordinated rather than organic. An attacker must complete real, costly, verified work for each fake identity, while honest agents keep the reputation they earned.
